artist: Leanne Rhimes (kar file made by Delisha Feb.5,2000)
title: You light up my life
lyrics_synced:
[00:08.57] So many nights, I'd sit by my window,
[00:17.14] Waiting for someone to sing me his song.
[00:25.71] So many dreams, I kept deep inside me,
[00:33.93] Alone in the dark, now you've come along.
[00:42.50] And you light up my life,
[00:49.29] You give me hope, to carry on.
[00:57.50] You light up my days
[01:02.14] And fill my nights with song.
[01:12.86] Rollin' at sea, adrift on the waters
[01:21.43] Could it be finally, I'm turning for home
[01:30.00] Finally a chance to say, "Hey, I Love You"
[01:38.57] Never again to be all alone.
[01:46.79] And you light up my life,
[01:53.57] You give me hope, to carry on.
[02:01.79] You light up my days
[02:06.43] And fill my nights with song.
[02:15.00] It can't be wrong, it feels so right
[02:27.94] 'Cause you, you light up my life.
